items.titleEn: 《Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game》进入“神通状态”

content.v: “神通状态”补丁今日正式登陆 XBOX Series X|S 平台的 Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game ，这也是该游戏发布以来规模最大的一次更新。本次更新为游戏菜单和对战界面带来了焕然一新的视觉效果，重构了两名角色，推出了“排位模式 2.0”，并针对故事模式、对战模式以及在线游玩进行了多项体验优化，同时还对所有登场角色的平衡性进行了调整。
自今年早些时候游戏发售以来，来自《降世神通：最后的气宗》和《降世神通：科拉传奇》的 12 名角色就备受玩家关注，我们的团队也一直密切关注着大家的战斗表现。此次补丁正是基于这些反馈而生，它呈现了我们最初构想的游戏形态，现在，是时候让你亲自上手体验了。
“神通状态”补丁包含内容：
重构角色：神通安昂与梦魇科拉

本次补丁的核心角色是“神通”宇宙中最强大的两位形态。工作室美术总监 Giancarlo Montalbano、美术总监 Santiago R. Villa 以及战斗总监 Young 分享了他们如何赋予这些角色生命，以及为何让这对组合走向截然不同的设计方向。“对于安昂，他的神通姿态旨在全方位提升他的气场；而对于科拉，这种姿态则是为了削弱她的存在感。一个庄重威严，另一个则显得慵懒而难以捉摸。”Villa 解释道。
神通安昂
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261031/YSDsocbughpqyld.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg

在神通状态下，安昂能够调动历代神通的力量。Young 指出，他与烈火王傲赛的最终决战是设计的主要参考点，同时还参考了系列中各个神通状态的经典瞬间。虽然平时的安昂活泼好动，但 Young 将这个版本描述为纯粹且压倒性的力量，只需微小的动作即可精准施展元素攻击。Villa 补充说，他是游戏中唯一采用底部打光的角色，这种刻意的设计让他看起来更神秘，更具 BOSS 的压迫感。Young 最喜欢的招式是他的标志性特殊技“神通飞升”（Avatar’s Ascension），该招式会将他提升至一个气球中，其中包含了许多对傲赛之战的致敬。
他全新的 4 级必杀技是他最强大的攻击，并请来了一位特殊嘉宾：直接源自《冬至》两集特别篇的神通罗库（Avatar Roku）。“安昂直接显现历代神通对他来说是非常独特的设定，”Young 说，“所以我们觉得必须把它做进去！”
梦魇科拉
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261031/YbWTDHbughpqAeE.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg
Young 解释道，梦魇科拉是《降世神通：科拉传奇》剧集中困扰科拉的黑暗镜像，同时还参考了她在第三季末尾与扎希尔的最后决战。“她是那种狂暴状态的体现……同时也是一种类似幽灵的诡异存在，所以我们想尖锐地捕捉这两个侧面。你会看到她拖着脚步缓慢移动与突然爆发出的重链挥击或瞬间移动之间的巨大反差。”Villa 注意到，她现在双腕都戴着锁链，这象征着这些枷锁在她的故事中承载的沉重意义。
她的视觉特效是游戏中最为疯狂的之一。Montalbano 特别提到了她必杀技中的水银效果，以及一个通过鱼眼镜头拉近并转化为瓦图（Vaatu）的胜利姿态，他称这“与游戏中其他内容相比非常独特”。
战斗系统更新
战斗平衡
此次更新内容丰富，以下是两项重大调整：
阿祖拉（Azula）的“野心火花”（Ambition’s Spark，专属聚焦姿态招式）得到了大幅增强，显著提升了玩法多样性。它现在能自动追踪并更接近对手位置，其爆炸范围更大，且支持流转取消（flow cancelable）。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261031/OtpydtbughpqBtF.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg
索卡（Sokka）的剑术特殊技在特定条件下使用皮安道大师（Master Piandao）支援时，现在可以直接取消并衔接回力镖投掷！当剑术连击达到 10 层以上时，索卡即可在剩余的对战中永久解锁该能力！
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261031/RMCIESbughpqDlE.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg
角色投票：选出下一位格斗家

《星际火狐重制版》的核心玩法包括复古街机式空战、固定轨道射击、可分支的任务路线和高分挑战。该作目前在Steam收到的玩家反馈较为分化：部分玩家认可其以较低价格提供了类似《星际火狐》的体验，也有玩家认为成品仍显粗糙，尚不足以推荐。

content.v: 作为史上最长寿的MMO之一，《RuneScape》的重启项目《RuneScape：重燃》生命周期短得离谱，连几种苍蝇的存活时间都比它长。按照原计划，官方将开设全新服务器，新账号将体验软重置后的游戏内容，老玩家则可继续在原服务器保留原有进度游玩。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793409651_519248.jpg
该计划在符文节活动上重磅公布后，立刻引发老玩家不满——他们觉得官方为了吸引新玩家，将老玩家抛在身后、边缘化处理。几周后开发商Jagex就取消了这一计划，并为此致歉。
看到Jagex听取玩家反馈、保留现有游戏内容，很多《RuneScape》粉丝松了口气;但也有部分玩家对没能赶上新账号冲级竞速、或是重新开荒的机会感到失望;还有些玩家压根搞不懂Jagex到底想做什么。为此我采访了《RuneScape》的创意总监瑞安·菲尔波特——也就是玩家熟知的Mod瑞安，来拆解这件事的来龙去脉。
“重燃”计划原本是“复兴之路”更新规划的收官之作。过去一年里，Jagex大力剔除了游戏中大量机制与商业化层面的积弊——正是这些问题，让《RuneScape》的人气远不如同系列的《旧版RuneScape》。菲尔波特表示，该规划的目标之一，就是让《RuneScape》“能和《旧版RuneScape》并肩而立”。
谈及“重燃”的规划初衷，他表示：“我们觉得这是个绝佳的时机。游戏现在正处于有史以来最好的状态——至少是近五到十年来的巅峰。借此契机，我们认为可以再次敞开大门，吸引更多玩家加入。”
采访中我用了“重启”这个说法，菲尔波特表示内部也这么称呼这个项目。但他强调：“我们的目标不只是‘招揽新玩家’这么简单。这不是唯一的目的。我们真正的想法是，这么优秀的游戏，要怎么才能打破圈层，让更多人知道它的存在?”
从很多层面来说，《RuneScape》的制作团队都想给这款游戏一次重新证明自己的机会——让玩家看到，如今的游戏比大众印象中的更健康、更好玩。菲尔波特表示，他们从没想过要割裂玩家群体，或是让《RuneScape》分裂成两个并行的版本。
菲尔波特回应道：“你提到了游戏分支的问题，但我们其实没这么想。说到底，这和推出新游戏模式是一个道理，比如之前的铁人模式、组队铁人模式等等，都是游戏的不同玩法而已。”他表示，“重燃”原本也是同样的定位，重燃服务器最终说不定还会和主服务器合并。但部分玩家把它当成了全新的游戏分支，认为这会分流玩家群体，还会掩盖玩家过去的游戏成就。
他补充道：“我觉得这里面存在一些沟通偏差。玩家不会损失任何东西，但大家的感受并非如此。符文节的现场演讲、玩家的个人解读，再加上Jagex后续发布的博客，信息传递出现了偏差。我们的初衷是‘让大家一起体验类似全新上线的氛围’，但玩家担心，这款刚有起色的老游戏，会被一个从没经历过那些机制问题的新版本抢了风头。而且对于这类账号成长维度极丰富的MMO来说，从头开始意味着要放弃太多积累。”
菲尔波特表示，Jagex原本就料到会有“部分反对声音”，毕竟众口难调，但“重燃”公布后引发的讨论热度，还是“超出了我的预期”。他认为，团队快速回应争议、最终决定取消“重燃”计划，恰恰说明公司现在更懂得在行动前考量玩家的意愿，也证明官方不会为了扩大玩家基数，牺牲现有玩家的游戏体验。
“我们从不排斥改变想法。”他说，“我们只想做对游戏最有利的选择。这款游戏能走过25年，靠的就是玩家的支持，以及一次次正确的决策。想要再走下一个25年，关键永远是做出正确的选择。”随着“重燃”计划取消，下一个重要节点是12月2日。菲尔波特称，那天依然是入坑《RuneScape》的第二好时机，而最好的时机，永远是当下。
很多调整的核心，都是为了给这款游戏一次重生的机会。明年，Jagex会把重心放在玩法再平衡上，推出更灵活的更新，回应玩家在Reddit上“这个需求我们提了374天”的吐槽。
菲尔波特坚称，哪怕和一两年前相比，如今的《RuneScape》也已经好了太多、健康了太多。他表示，和之前那段低迷时期相比，现在的开发工作“简直是天壤之别，而且是向好的方向”。虽然他“巴不得早点移除寻宝猎人这类氪金系统”，但现在游戏终于摆脱了这么多糟粕，感觉非常好。
“我们不会再犯同样的错误。”菲尔波特说，“《RuneScape》还会再走过25年，我对此充满期待。期待今年年底的更新，期待明年的规划，更期待未来三年、五年、七年、九年后，这款游戏会走向何方。”

content.v: CD Projekt RED近日回顾了《 巫师3：狂猎 》两部大型资料片的定价思路。全球社区与社交媒体总监Marcin Momot表示，团队开发期间始终希望提供真正物有所值的内容，并认为最终达到了这一目标。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793412536_620146_jpg_r.jpg
《巫师3：狂猎》于2015年推出资料片《石之心》，次年发布《血与酒》。相关内容将两部资料片的体验时长分别形容为30小时以上，当年的扩展通行证售价约为24.99美元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793412539_348990_jpg_r.jpg
Momot称，《巫师3：狂猎》既是工作室首款 开放世界 游戏，也是团队首次在广阔且自由的环境中检验自身的叙事理念，扩展通行证同样是这份雄心的一部分。购买通行证意味着玩家相信团队能够继续扩充游戏，两部资料片也被视为对这份支持的回报。
工作室后来还免费推出了《巫师3：狂猎》重制升级，基础版玩家可升级至完整版，并免费获得《石之心》和《血与酒》。另有消息称，新资料片《往昔之歌》计划于次年推出，但它是否会延续较低定价，目前尚无官方答案。

content.v: 第一人称动作RPG《女王之域》于10月31日正式推出，登陆PC（Steam）、Nintendo Switch 2、PS5和Xbox Series X|S。游戏由Future Friends Games发行，开发团队称其受到FromSoftware于1994年推出的《国王密令》启发，是一封写给该系列的情书。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793412450_458801_jpg_r.jpg
玩家将前往充满谜团的尼亚西德岛寻找失踪的父亲。邪恶力量盘踞岛上，各个迷宫区域无缝相连，其中隐藏着大量秘密，探索和寻找路线是游戏的主要内容之一。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793412454_566740_jpg_r.jpg
探索途中，玩家可以取得传说圣剑“Endu”，通过强化圣剑增加跳跃距离，在不同立足点之间移动。路线设计由此侧重穿越和立体探索，部分区域需要借助不断提升的移动能力抵达。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793412456_191829_jpg_r.jpg
战斗系统强调耐力管理，玩家可以组合蓄力攻击、武器专属特殊攻击及二十多种副投掷武器，对抗一百多种怪物和强力首领。游戏还提供五十多种可发现并强化的近战武器。
角色可通过经验值升级、进食提高属性，并搭配饰品形成不同构筑。Steam商店页面显示，本作内容量可达数十小时。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 现在推荐PC游戏再合适不过，但尴尬的是，如今组装一台游戏PC的难度也创下新高。主机市场增长乏力、早已进入成熟期，而PC游戏成了整个行业年度增长的核心驱动力。PC平台常年涌现出更多元化的头部游戏作品，也有越来越多开发者（尤其是亚洲厂商）加大了对该平台的投入。但PC游戏的核心优势究竟是什么?
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793409335_951383.jpg
我就PC游戏的增长话题，采访了市场分析机构Newzoo的市场情报总监埃马纽埃尔·罗西耶。PC平台的部分优势显而易见：比如PC玩家有Steam这个功能完善的核心商店，操作方式更丰富，支持键鼠与手柄，模组支持更完善，画质上限更高，而且PC除了玩游戏、做直播之外还有更多实用价值。但除此之外，还有不少其他推动因素。
“我研究过这个问题，两者的商业模式差异很有意思。”罗西耶在谈及PC与主机的差异时表示，“PC平台的营收有一半来自内购，因为很多PC游戏都是免费游玩模式，大量作品都是长线运营的服务型游戏。而主机平台目前仍是买断制占主导，是最核心的商业模式。”
不过即便在主机平台，最卖座的买断游戏也多是年货体育系列，或是《使命召唤》这类量级的大作，它们本质上和服务型游戏类似，都是“体验的持续延伸”。罗西耶说：“你可以把它看作是同一系列带来的持续性收入。”
这种现象在PC平台没那么明显。罗西耶补充道，一方面体育游戏在PC端的体量小很多，另一方面“这多少也和受众群体有关”。翻看Newzoo这类机构的报告，统计每月最赚钱、游玩量最高的游戏时会发现，PC平台总能涌现出更多新作和独立游戏，尽管榜单前十依然被《我的世界》《堡垒之夜》《罗布乐思》这类头部作品占据。
《大步走》就是个很典型的例子：它在PS5上的用户量更高，因为加入了PS Plus会员库，但它在PC端赚的钱反而多得多。这款游戏因BDS抵制运动没有登陆Xbox，独立游戏神作《蔚蓝》近期也做出了同样的选择。
罗西耶表示：“总体而言PC玩家的选择更多。对很多独立发行商来说，先在Steam、在PC端发售游戏，反响好再拓展到主机平台，门槛要低得多。PC玩家的选择更丰富，也就意味着头部大作的集中度没那么高，毕竟可选的内容实在太多了。”
Newzoo预测，整体游戏市场仍会保持增长，但“主机的增速会低于PC和移动端”。主机在亚洲市场的拓展一直不顺，尤其是在任天堂和索尼的本土日本之外的地区，而PC游戏在中国这样的人口大国正蓬勃发展。此外，主机的定价问题也十分严峻，新一代主机的价格可能会劝退那些代代都换新主机的老玩家，更别说那些本就不愿为核心平台更新换代的新玩家了。
PC端也面临着AI数据中心需求推高硬件价格的问题，但Newzoo发现，即便如此PC游戏依然保持增长。这不仅仅是新用户增长带来的，罗西耶认为，当下PC游戏的入门门槛其实可能更低，毕竟“大多数家庭本来就有电脑”。谈及AI带来的成本上涨，罗西耶认为，AI对电子游戏的初步影响对消费者来说偏负面，因为消费者陷入了被动，困在糟糕的消费市场环境里动弹不得。
罗西耶发现：“过去两三年里，PC游戏一直乘着发展的东风高歌猛进。这很有意思，因为回看2015到2020年，PC市场几乎停滞不前，反而是主机靠着服务型游戏、《堡垒之夜》这类作品一路高歌。但现在情况完全反过来了。”
“主机似乎已经触碰到了增长天花板，但PC还在持续增长。我今早刚和团队讨论过，我们可能需要上调2026年PC游戏市场的增长预期，因为不少发行商上半年的PC端业绩非常亮眼，部分实现了两位数的高增长。PC市场的增长势头十分强劲。而且我认为，索尼此前决定将部分独占游戏搬上PC，虽然后续有所收缩，但这也推动了更多玩家转向PC平台——毕竟他们几乎能玩到所有独占作品了。”
一旦体验过PC游戏，很多人就很难再回到纯主机的游玩方式。PC平台当然也有自己的问题——比如糟糕的移植优化、Windows系统的各种疏漏、繁琐的设置调试，随便就能数出三个。但肯定不止我一个人，越来越愿意坐在电脑前玩游戏，哪怕我依然喜欢窝在沙发上，守着我的三台主机。

content.v: 《GTA6》会让玩家决定，自己究竟要当一个多么冷酷的罪犯。R星将加入一套新系统，玩家的选择会影响杰森和露西亚的故事。
《GTA》系列一直很强调自由度。玩家可以抢劫商家、偷车，也可以和警方交火，在 开放世界 里制造各种混乱。但在过去的作品中，玩家通常没有太多理由考虑这些犯罪行为会带来什么后果。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793411516_657497_jpg_r.jpg
《GTA6》从《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中借鉴了一些做法。《荒野大镖客：救赎2》会用荣誉系统记录亚瑟·摩根在游戏中的行为。玩家做出的善恶选择，会改变其他角色对待亚瑟的态度，甚至会影响故事结局。
《GTA6》在这个思路上继续扩展，但它的新系统关注的不是角色有多善良或多邪恶，而是玩家会用什么方式从事犯罪活动。
R星在接受《Edge》杂志采访时确认，《GTA6》将加入一套名为“犯罪档案”的系统。它会记录杰森和露西亚的行为，并用一条从“专业”到“无可救药”的尺度，判断他们属于哪一类罪犯。游戏会用天使和恶魔图标来表示这套系统。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793411516_216936_jpg_r.jpg
如果玩家做事更加谨慎，提前规划犯罪行动，就能建立起“专业”的名声。如果玩家每次遇到问题都选择 暴力 解决，就会逐渐走向这条尺度的另一端。
更重要的是，R星已经确认，玩家在这方面的选择会影响《GTA6》的故事发展。这意味着“犯罪档案”不只是一个用来展示行为倾向的摆设。
战斗方式也会因此发生明显变化。玩家不再需要每次都杀死敌人。杰森和露西亚可以让对手失去行动能力，也可以先威胁或恐吓对方，不必马上动用暴力。
当然，游戏不会强制玩家这么做。玩家仍然可以一路开枪，靠杀死敌人解决遭遇。但如果经常这样处理问题，“犯罪档案”就会越来越偏向暴力的一端。
这对《GTA6》来说是一个很有意思的新设计。这个系列过去的许多任务，往往都会以枪战收场。现在，玩家可能会更愿意谨慎处理某些情况，尤其是在自己的选择可能影响后续剧情时。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793411516_136306_jpg_r.jpg
“犯罪档案”系统也符合R星对《GTA6》的整体设计方向。开发商希望开放世界和玩法能够更明显地回应玩家的决定。R星已经确认，NPC的行为、警方的反应，以及玩家完成任务时的自由度都会得到改进。
有些任务目标会提供多条行动路线。还有一些遭遇不会强迫玩家沿固定路线继续，而是可以自然地转入开放世界系统。 再加上威胁敌人和让敌人失去行动能力等功能，“犯罪档案”系统可能会让《GTA6》玩起来比前作少很多限制。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793411516_907858_jpg_r.jpg
不过，R星还没有具体说明，这套系统究竟会怎样改变故事。它是否会影响单独的任务、角色对话或游戏结局，目前也不清楚。预计R星在游戏发售前也不会公布这些细节。
无论最终如何，根据玩家实施犯罪的方式，让故事出现不同结果的设计，都算得上《GTA6》的一项重大进展。

content.v: 生活节奏很快，我们很难抽出时间做自己真正喜欢的事。有时候，一想到一部动画有几百集，连点开第一集的动力都没了。好在有些动画集数不多，只用一季就讲完了完整的故事，很适合周末集中看完。
只要花上几个小时，就能看完一段情节完整、节奏紧凑、制作精良的故事。不用忍受拖剧情，也不用花很长时间追更。下面这五部短篇动画类型各不相同，都可以从周五下午开始看，在周日晚上前看完。
第一部是《赛博朋克：边缘行者》，全剧10集
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793410728_473515_jpg_r.jpg
这部动画由扳机社和CD Projekt RED合作制作。开播后，它在动画领域引起了很大反响，也成了反乌托邦科幻故事中的代表性作品。
故事发生在危险的夜之城。街头少年大卫·马丁内斯生活在这座痴迷科技和身体改造的大都市里，只想努力活下去。一场严重的个人悲剧发生后，大卫给自己装上了一个来历不明的军用级义体，随后加入了一群游走在法律之外的雇佣兵。这些人被称为“边缘行者”。
全剧只有10集，每集大约24分钟，四个小时左右就能看完。故事推进得非常快，画面带有强烈的迷幻感，霓虹色彩十分醒目，配乐也很有冲击力。剧情没有绕弯子，而是很快切入重点，从头到尾讲完了一条悲剧色彩浓厚、冲击力很强的故事线。
如果看完后还不过瘾，它的第二季刚刚推出。不过，第二季不会接着讲原来的故事，而是在同一个背景下讲述另一段故事。毕竟，夜之城里还有成千上万个故事等着被发掘。
第二部是《只有我不在的街道》，全剧12集
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793410728_381545.jpg
如果你喜欢神秘事件、时间旅行和心理 悬疑 ，也喜欢那种让人忍不住一集接一集看下去的作品，那么A-1 Pictures改编的《只有我不在的街道》是一个稳妥的选择。
藤沼悟29岁，是一名事业不顺的漫画家。他拥有一种名叫“再上映”的超自然能力，而且无法主动控制。这种能力可以让他回到几分钟前，阻止身边即将发生的悲剧。
后来，悟被诬陷杀害了自己的母亲。他的能力也随之失控，直接把他送回了18年前，也就是他还在上小学的时候。悟意识到，如果想拯救现在的母亲，就必须先查清同班同学雏月加代失踪并被杀害的案件。
全剧共有12集，几乎每一集结尾都会留下悬念，让人很难停下来。这部惊悚动画很容易让人投入感情。它一边展现对童年生活的怀念，一边保持犯罪故事带来的紧张感，很适合从周六看到周日，一口气追完。
第三部是《紫罗兰永恒花园》，全剧13集
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793410728_301484_jpg_r.jpg
如果你想看一部重点描写情感成长、带有历史剧元素，同时画面精美得像绘画一样的动画，那么京都动画的这部作品不容错过。
故事的主角是薇尔莉特。她是一名孤儿，从小就被训练成致命的战争工具。战争结束后，她失去了自己的指挥官。指挥官临终前对她说了最后一句话，但她一直无法理解这句话的意思。
为了重新适应普通人的生活，薇尔莉特成为了一名“自动手记人偶”。简单来说，她的工作就是替别人写信，帮助委托人把内心深处难以说出口的感情写下来。
全剧共有13集，采用单元剧结构。每封信都是一个相对独立的故事，也让薇尔莉特逐渐理解爱、哀悼和共情。作品的动画有电影级水准，管弦乐配乐也十分出色。《紫罗兰永恒花园》适合在周日下午慢下来，仔细欣赏。
第四部是《恶魔人Crybaby》，全剧10集
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793410728_108531.webp
这部作品改编自永井豪的经典原作，由风格独特的导演汤浅政明执导，Science SARU负责制作。它采用了冲击力很强的表现方式，也触及了不少禁忌话题。
不动明是一名感情细腻的年轻人。他从朋友飞鸟了那里得知，一个古老的恶魔种族已经回归，并企图从人类手中夺走地球的控制权。
想要对抗这些恶魔，唯一的办法就是与恶魔融合，同时不能失去人类的内心。于是，不动明变成了恶魔人。他拥有野兽般的力量，却依然保留着人类的灵魂。此后，暴力不断升级，全球范围内的偏执情绪也变得越来越严重。
全剧只有10集，推进速度快得让人目不暇接。动画风格流畅，又带有很强的实验性，和常见的动画作品很不一样。它残酷而露骨，在哲学层面也带有强烈的毁灭感。虽然很快就能看完，但那个震撼的结局会留下很深的印象。
第五部是《死亡游行》，全剧12集
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793410728_696550.jpg
《死亡游行》是一部风格独特的心理剧。它通过死后世界里的道德审判，探讨人性。
当两个人在现实世界中同时死亡，他们既不会直接去天堂，也不会马上下地狱，而是会在奎因德基姆酒吧醒来。迎接他们的是神秘酒保德基姆，而他的另一个身份是灵魂的裁决者。
德基姆需要判断死者的灵魂应该转世重生，还是被送入虚无。为此，他会强迫死者参加一些看上去没什么危险的酒吧游戏。随着游戏继续，参与者会承受越来越大的压力，并逐渐暴露自己最黑暗的秘密和真实本性。
全剧共有12集。每个单元故事都相对完整，而且充满紧张感。同时，作品还有一条贯穿全剧的主线，讲述裁决者的起源和人类的情感。酒吧氛围经过了精心设计，整体美术风格优雅，片头曲也很有辨识度。这些特点让它既有新鲜感，也很容易让人一集接一集地看下去。

据每日经济新闻消息，三只松鼠（300783.SZ）发布2026年三季报。表面看，这份“成绩单”不算难看，前三季度营收73.22亿元，同比下滑5.63%；归母净利润2.57亿元，同比增长59.71%；扣非后的归母净利润1.92亿元，同比增速高达236.66%，利润大幅增长。

三只松鼠近年来营收和业绩承压、增速放缓甚至出现下滑，主要受线上渠道结构失衡、流量成本高企、行业竞争加剧等多重因素影响。

content.v: 快科技10月31日消息，苹果今天正式官宣，Apple智能的首批核心功能包括实时翻译、照片app中的消除工具以及写作工具等，将于11月4日起开放测试。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/31/small_202610310924089342.jpg
官方表示，Apple智能深度整合于用户日常使用的各种app与体验中，助力用户轻松书写、表达自我，并高效处理各项事务。
Apple智能由Apple构建的生成式模型驱动，帮助用户通过实时翻译功能跨越语言障碍；通过写作工具改写、校对和摘要；通过视觉智能快速了解身边事物的更多信息；通过消除工具去除照片中的干扰对象；通过智绘表情创作契合当下心境的新表情符号，以及更多其他功能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/31/small_202610310924196273.jpg
此外，Apple与阿里巴巴达成合作，在部分Apple智能体验中加入对千问的支持，让中国用户能直接在Siri、写作工具以及视觉智能中使用阿里巴巴的千问，包括文本与图像理解相关功能。
这一系列Apple智能功能将自11月4日起随最新的iOS开发者Beta版开放测试，并将于12月iOS 27.3正式发布时面向中国用户推出。
其他平台的支持将在获得必要审批后推出。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/31/small_202610310924327048.jpg
需要注意的是，苹果强调本次更新不包含Siri AI及Apple在WWDC 2026上宣布的其他下一代Apple智能功能。
以下是Apple即将在支持的iPhone上向中国用户推出的首批功能：
-实时翻译功能帮助用户在发送信息或交谈时跨特定语言进行交流，并无缝整合在信息、FaceTime通话和电话app中。用户还可通过支持主动降噪的AirPods 4，以及AirPods Pro 2及后续机型使用该功能，实时翻译面对面对话。
-写作工具可帮助用户改写、校对和摘要输入的文本。
-视觉智能帮助用户通过iPhone摄像头即时了解周围的物体和场所3。
-照片app的消除工具可去除干扰对象，同时原样呈现拍摄当时的意境。
-智绘表情让用户仅需输入文字描述，便可生成专属于自己的表情符号。
-照片app中的自然语言搜索让用户只需输入一段描述，就能更轻松地寻找某张照片或某段视频。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/31/small_202610310916238982.png
“没人能笑着走出理发店。”中国青年报的一项调查显示，77.5%的受访者对此深有同感。可如今，轮到理发店自己笑不出来了。
中国美发美容协会数据显示，2026年一季度，全国有21.3万家理发店注销、关停或转让。另一边，不洗头、不推销、不办卡的10元快剪却在猛猛开店，就连北上广深这样的一线城市，也出现了大量10元快剪门口排队的场景。有网友调侃：打败“理发刺客”的，竟是超市里的10元快剪。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/31/small_202610310916354181.png
理发店，大概是全国“头衔通胀”最严重的地方。普通设计师、设计总监、首席理发师、店长……托尼老师的名目多到让人眼花缭乱。有消费者调侃，同一位理发师，上个月还是普通设计师，这个月就升成了技术总监，变的是头衔，没变的是手艺和推销热情。
消费者被办卡话术骚扰过、被预付卡坑过、也为虚高的头衔买过单，于是开始寻找理发的第二选择。有人投奔10元快剪，有人网购理发器在家自己推，有人干脆留长发。理发的需求并没有消失，顾客只是换了个地方坐下。
在10元快剪店里，没有收银员，没有洗头台，也没有推销办卡。顾客在门口扫码取票，等叫号，坐下剪完就走。让很多人意外的是，快剪早已不再是中年男人的专属，年轻上班族占到客流的一半以上。

content.v: 素来以直言著称的资深RPG开发者马克·达拉，数年前退休前一直执掌《龙腾世纪》系列的开发工作。他预测，《星球大战：旧共和国的命运》将采用更精简凝练的叙事，规避他所认为的BioWare近年作品中叙事过度堆砌的问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793409094_412679.jpg

达拉在接受Eldorado.gg采访时，探讨了由前《质量效应》核心负责人凯西·哈德森主导的《星球大战：旧共和国的命运》的潜在开发方向。达拉猜测，哈德森或许会打造一款《旧共和国武士3》式的精神续作，也有可能做成“套着星战IP的《质量效应》类作品”。他补充称，自己最终也无法确定这款游戏的最终形态。本作显然不由BioWare参与开发，制作工作由哈德森创立的阿卡诺特工作室负责。即便如此，哈德森的加盟，还是让达拉对本作的一项特质十分笃定。
“有一点我可以肯定，那就是这款游戏的电影化叙事会非常出色，因为这是凯西格外看重的部分。”达拉表示，“我坚信他们会在这方面投入大量精力。所以这会是一款主打叙事的游戏，而且叙事表达会十分到位。但至于围绕叙事搭建的游戏整体架构是什么样，我就完全没把握了，根本无从猜测。但要说它能不能讲好一个故事?那是肯定的，这点我非常有信心。”
当被问及哈德森是否会将在BioWare任职时总结的经验带到《旧共和国的命运》的开发中时，达拉证实：“凯西和我聊过这件事。”他补充道：“我觉得他肯定会着手简化叙事的呈现方式。某种程度上，你可以说BioWare的叙事已经有点自我沉溺、过于臃肿了。我想凯西可能也意识到了这一点。所以他或许会做减法，回归更纯粹的经典英雄之旅。我也说不准，可能我有点妄加揣测了。”
尽管达拉不愿过度臆测，但《龙腾世纪：面纱守卫》的剧情确实饱受争议——其中既有针对游戏多元元素的恶意抨击，也有老粉丝发自内心的失望。我倒不觉得简化叙事一定是最该吸取的教训，但不得不说，《旧共和国的命运》确实交到了靠谱的开发者手里。

items.title: Stranger Than Heaven Features Optional “Cheats” to Make its Combat Easier
items.summary: Stranger Than Heaven Features Optional “Cheats” to Make its Combat Easier

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/05/20/strangerthumb-1779284528353.png

Stranger Than Heaven, the upcoming street-brawler from the makers of Yakuza and Like a Dragon, will feature optional in-game assists to make its challenging new combat system more approachable, developer RGG Studio has confirmed to IGN in an interview conducted at Gamescom Asia x Thailand Game Show 2026 this week.

In IGN’s most recent hands-on with the game , my colleague Michael Higham described Stranger Than Heaven’s parry-based combat system as “demanding”, adding that “you really have to pay attention to attack animations not just for timing, but to make the correct call on the direction it's coming from.” This initially seemed like it could prove to be divisive among fans of the comparatively carefree button-mashing combo systems found in RRG Studios’ previous adventures like Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii and Lost Judgment, but it turns out that Stranger Than Heaven’s more complex combat system will only be as difficult as players want it to be.

“We knew mechanics like parrying would be challenging, but based on feedback from players who tried the hands-on demos at various game shows, like [Gamescom Asia], we’ve fine-tuned details like difficulty balance and control responsiveness,” said Hiroyuki Sakamoto, producer of Stranger Than Heaven. "We've also included difficulty settings and provided plenty of support features, such as cheat items that increase health regeneration. We believe that if we offer enough support for action-game beginners, it will give them the chance to play through to the very end.”

Sakamoto insisted that with some perseverance from players and the inclusion of a lengthy tutorial phase in the early stages of the game to help them, he hoped that most players will eventually start to enjoy the new mechanics. However, for players who perhaps want to purely focus on enjoying the multiple decade-spanning story and the showbiz-based side activities without mastering the rhythm of the combat, the addition of the cheat items should mean that all fans of RGG Studio’s games will be able to enjoy Stranger Than Heaven.

“Equipping those cheat items makes you much harder to defeat by automatically restoring health and providing other perks,” explained Sakamoto. “For beginners who still struggle with blocking, we’re prepared assistance items that let you clear encounters using basic left and right punches alone.”
There is one small catch to using these assist items, however, but it’s a fairly humorous one in typically cheeky RGG Studio style.

“You can obtain [the cheat items] right from the start of the game,” said Sakamoto. “But because they function as ‘handicap’ items and you wear it as a cloth/garment, anyone watching your gameplay screen will immediately notice you’re wearing them.”
So no activating cheats and pretending to be an absolute parry-beast on a livestream, then.
Stranger Than Heaven is set for release on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC on January 15, 2027.

items.title: Monster Hunter Outlanders Review So Far
items.summary: This mobile spin-off maintains the gameplay loop and visuals of its console counterparts, with the caveat of h

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/30/monsterhunteroutlanders-blogroll-1793403161038.jpg

Few games have changed the trajectory of their respective series quite like Monster Hunter World, one of the biggest smash hits Capcom has ever created. World was a vibrant, expansive, and ambitious leap that paid off in spades. It makes sense, then, that eight years later the series would still be chasing that high. Even with the time that's passed, I find myself amazed that Monster Hunter Outlanders, essentially, manages to cram the experience of World into a mobile game. This mobile spinoff certainly isn't attempting to reinvent the wheel, but after six hours with the game, it's proving to be a surprisingly competent package, although I have some bubbling hesitations about the grind and encroaching gacha systems.

Anytime there's a mobile spinoff of a major series, the first question that comes to mind is how that game will be compromised, or truncated, from that full console or PC experience. And so often, those mobile games are simplifications of a larger idea, like Fire Emblem Heroes or Diablo Immortal. What I've found fascinating about Monster Hunter Outlanders so far is that it doesn't really simplify the overall gameplay loop and structure. Rather, it's sort of a reconfigured Monster Hunter that strings out progression to support the typical framework of a mobile game, one filled with nearly a half-dozen different currencies to keep track of at any given time. But it also very much feels like Outlanders wants players to engage with it like a full-fledged Monster Hunter, and even includes all the story exposition you'd expect to go along with it.

Like most Monster Hunter games, Outlanders begins with a big cinematic opening where a group of adventurers from the Adventurer's Guild are striking out to an uncharted part of the world – in this case, an island called Aesoland. This island is filled with Radiant species of monsters, beasts whose abilities have been enhanced by a mineral called Radiantite. This is, ostensibly, also the game's reasoning for creating new designs of classic series monsters and tweaking their abilities to match this game specifically, like the Pukei-Pukei focusing more on head or tail attacks, which are easier to target with Outlander's more streamlined lock-on system.

But I cannot stress enough how much Outlanders banks on the same formula as World; it's almost as if the same game was transposed onto different locations and story elements. Even the first area of the game, like World, is a heavily forested area with a lot of verticality for climbing or setting ambushes; intentionally designed to show you the ropes. If you've played any Monster Hunter game, you know that core gameplay loop of what to expect – you take missions or hunts, track down monsters in an instanced map, beat them, harvest materials, and then use said materials to craft more powerful equipment.

Complementing this, you have a moderately-sized open world that you can roam around and explore to take down smaller monsters, find crafting materials, and more. Outlanders also brings back many of the elements that have become mainstays since World: scoutfly trails to guide you to objectives, buildable objects on the map like towers and ziplines, and monsters that interact and fight each other like natural predators. All these elements click together just as well as they did in World, creating a compelling loop that feels like you're constantly doing something meaningful to that overall progress. Outlanders is also impressive in terms of presentation with environments that genuinely look stunning; playing on an iPhone 14 Plus, I had a consistent framerate with very few dips.

However, the differences start to surface as you dig deeper into the minutiae of how the game actually plays and what options are available in combat scenarios. Certain aspects of the combat have been streamlined to fit the mobile experience and accommodate a touchscreen control scheme instead of a controller (although there is controller support if you want it). Movement and actions aren't as intricate, although the game sports two different control methods: Adventure Mode and Classic Mode. The former is intended for new players and streamlines things down to three buttons, Attack, React, and Burst. From there, the game contextually handles a lot of what you're doing, like the React button allowing you to dodge when a monster attacks, or block if the time is right. Classic Mode, on the other hand, gives you full manual control, including traditional button-stringed combos.

What I've found so far, though, is that Classic Mode proves to be unfit for just touch controls, as it's too cumbersome to use all of these different options without a controller. Adventure Mode does, generally, feel good to use, but takes some of the vibrant friction out of the experience by streamlining so much. That means the ideal way to play this, if you can, is on Classic Mode with a controller – which then ultimately raises the question of why you wouldn't just play a console Monster Hunter. There are answers to that question, of course, like if you don't own anything else to play a Monster Hunter game on.

The other two major elements where Outlanders shifts that classic experience is with your ability to build a party of adventurers and how progression works. To try and fit the typical idea of a gacha game, Outlanders creates a group of distinct characters that take part in the story who you can then recruit and use as NPC companions. Recruiting means partaking in those traditional gacha pulls using currency called Rutacoins.

Each Adventurer has their own distinct moveset that builds on one specific weapon type, meaning playing as that Adventurer is different from just slapping any other weapon on your player-created character. This does create some incentive to try and get these various characters. Of course, the real key to this system is how easy or difficult it might be to pull Adventurers and upgrade them to be useful in combat. I was able to build a full four-person party fairly easily with the currency I earned from starting the game. Overall, I like the idea of being able to build a party with these distinct characters and play solo. The option is still there to group up with other players and friends, but the Adventurers make it easy to tackle quests and Contracts on your own. But I can already see hints of it being frustrating to pull repeat characters, let alone anyone new you might want down the line.

This leads to the area I'm not as hot on: the progression system. While almost all of the currency in the game is earnable from playing, as well as spending real money, I'm finding that the classic Monster Hunter progression loop feels a bit slower here. You need Zenny to pay for items, upgrades, and services. Rutacoins are for pulling characters and sidekicks (Palicos and the like). Research Points needed for the upgradable skill tree to unlock more buildable structures, for example. And as you might expect, there are additional materials necessary for upgrading a character or sidekick's level, unlocking their level cap, upgrading weapons, crafting items, and more.

items.title: Chronicles: Medieval Developer 'At Real Risk of Closing' Before Release as Funding 'No Longer in Place'
items.summary: Chronicles: Medieval developer Raw Power Games posted a chilling warning on its social media pages, warning th

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/31/chronicles-1793407292181.jpg

Chronicles: Medieval developer Raw Power Games posted a chilling warning on its social media pages, warning that the studio might close before it can launch the Early Access version of its medieval open-world action/strategy sandbox because funding for the team is "no longer in place."

In a message on X (with a hat tip to Insider Gaming ), Raw Power laid out its unfortunate predicament: "Due to circumstances outside our control, the necessary funding behind Raw Power Games is no longer in place. Without it we can't keep building Chronicles: Medieval, and right now the studio is at real risk of closing. We're not going to sugarcoat. You deserve to hear it plainly, and directly from us.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/31/rawpower-1793408372778.jpg

"What makes it hurt is how close we are," the message continued. "Early Access is within reach. The world we've been building for years is finally starting to feel alive, and we have so much we've been thrilled to show you. Every day in the studio – in Copenhagen and remote – we've seen people put everything they have into this game, often far beyond what anyone asked of them. They are the ones carrying the heaviest weight right now, and we couldn't be prouder of them. We don't know yet how this ends. But in the spirit of our game we're not going down without a fight!"

Chronicles: Medieval's Tom Hardy-narrated announcement trailer drew a lot of interest, netting more than 2 million views on IGN's YouTube channel . It was revealed at Summer Game Fest 2025, and we have since previewed it not once but twice . In our most recent hands-on, we noted that it still felt pretty early at the time, but also said, "The scale and detail of the battles simultaneously is very impressive," and, "Being able to jump into a commander at ground level for more of a third-person action mode is really cool."

Raw Power Games told fans, "If you want to stand with us, keep Chronicles: Medieval on your wishlist and keep talking about it. It matters more right now than you might think. Thank you for believing in us. Thank you for believing in this game. We really hope you'll get to play the world we've been creating."

content.v: 《星球大战绝地3》的发售时间又有了一些新线索。作为《星球大战绝地：陨落的武士团》和《星球大战绝地2：幸存者》的续作，这款游戏目前还没有正式公布。不过，EA早在2024年就确认，游戏已经在开发。官方公开的信息暂时只有这些，非官方消息则透露了更多内容。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793408425_847888_jpg_r.jpg
消息来自彭博社记者Jason Schreier。据他透露，这款新的《星球大战》游戏“开发已进入后期阶段”，而且“应该很快就会正式公布”。遗憾的是，目前的新消息只有这些，没有更具体的细节。
《星球大战绝地2：幸存者》从正式公布到发售，中间只隔了11个月。照这个节奏来看，如果《星球大战绝地3》近期公布，距离发售可能也不会太久。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793408818_960514_jpg_r.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793408818_788024_jpg_r.jpg
此前有传闻称，这款游戏会在2027年发售。如果传闻准确，它可能会在现在到今年年底之间正式公布。这样看来，相关消息有可能出现在12月举行的游戏大奖颁奖典礼上。
前作是在2022年5月的“星球大战”庆典上正式公布的，但实机演示和发售日期直到当年晚些时候的游戏大奖（TGA）颁奖典礼上才公开。也就是说，这个系列以前确实在游戏大奖上发布过重要消息，这次或许也会如此。
不过，第三部游戏从公布到发售的间隔，甚至可能比前作更短。因为它已经是系列第三部作品，宣传方面未必需要太长的预热时间。所以，就算游戏没有在2026年公布，也仍有可能在2027年发售。外媒Comicbook预计它会在2027年亮相，更准确地说，可能是在2027年圣诞假期时。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261031/1793408869_292644_jpg_r.jpg
对于一直在等第三部卡尔·凯斯蒂斯游戏的玩家来说，这显然是个好消息。不过，《星球大战》粉丝这段时间也不是没有游戏可玩。今年最优秀的游戏之一，就是一款《星球大战》游戏。再加上《星球大战：银河赛车手》和《星球大战：零连队》，今年甚至可以说是《星球大战》游戏多年来表现最强劲的一年。
与此同时，同一位消息人士的另一份报告还提到，《星球大战》粉丝未来可以期待一款新的《星球大战：前线》游戏。不过，这款游戏显然距离发售还很远。

items.title: Xbox's Doom, Wolfenstein Developers Working 'More Closely Than Ever' Following Xbox 'Reset' Layoffs
items.summary: Bethesda and Xbox development studio id Software, maker of the Doom franchise, has deepened its partnership wi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/31/doom-1793406375983.jpg

Bethesda and Xbox development studio id Software, maker of the Doom franchise, has deepened its partnership with fellow Bethesda and Xbox studio MachineGames, makers of the most recent Wolfenstein games as well as 2024's Indiana Jones and the Great Circle.

At a press event earlier this week for id Software's Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations DLC, which was released this summer, studio co-director Marty Stratton was asked how the studio is doing in the wake of the layoffs that affected id as part of Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's ongoing Xbox " reset ." He answered, "We're doing great. Not to handwave the [layoffs] away...everybody knows we had about half of our studio exit as part of that. But there was a very deliberate effort to make sure that we were incredibly viable coming out of that across everything we do, across game development and technology department.

"We're working more closely with MachineGames than ever. We've always had a very close partnership with them, but I think we're at a point with technology development that both teams are incredibly talented and have incredibly talented engineers and we're really on an amazing path that had started pre-[layoffs]. We'd kicked this off earlier this year. We're really excited about that. We're both really really bullish on what we have ahead."

This is purely speculative on my part, but might the two decorated first-person shooter studios be co-developing MachineGames's next project, which is heavily rumored to be Wolfenstein 3 – with studio head Jerk Gustafsson saying, "We're not done with Wolfenstein yet"? Not only has MachineGames used id Software's idTech engine for every one of its games, but Sharma has publicly stated that she wants Xbox's development teams to double down on their biggest franchises – a sentiment echoed by Bethesda boss Jill Braff. And with id now seemingly done with Doom: The Dark Ages following the oustanding Revelations DLC, a team-up with MachineGames might help get the rumored third Wolfenstein game out the door faster, and getting games out more quickly is one of Sharma's goals.

In addition, while Doom should certainly be considered in that "biggest franchises" group, Wolfenstein most likely is as well. Plus, Amazon has a Wolfenstein TV series in development, which might further incentivize Xbox and Bethesda to pair up id and MachineGames to make sure the latter team's next game is as awesome – and out as quickly – as possible. Bu whatever either team does next, the project(s) will be highly anticipated, at least by me, as both teams have incredible track records, both historically and recently.

items.title: 《千棋百计》如何用肉鸽解放国际象棋
items.summary: “我并非国际象棋专家。意识到这一点非但没有让我气馁，反而激励了我。”

content.v: https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/headpic/2026/10/b69a68ef5b4b53998985aeba57c8e2f0.jpg
2006 年，鲍比·费舍尔（Bobby Fischer）在一档电台节目里宣判了国际象棋的死刑：“象棋已经彻底死了。它现在全是记忆和预先编排，非常无趣，毫无创造性。”
二十年后，马格努斯·卡尔森（Magnus Carlsen）用行动呼应了费舍尔的判断。他放弃了古典国际象棋世界冠军的卫冕机会，转而投身自由式象棋。这是一种开局棋子排列随机化的变体，足以让大量既有开局理论失效。2026 年 2 月，卡尔森在魏森豪斯赢得首届由 FIDE 正式认可的自由式象棋世界冠军赛冠军，这是他职业生涯的第 21 个世界级头衔。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/b9fcb8aec0e1e0a4fdf9e6ddefaf2e6c.png
费舍尔和卡尔森在说的，是同一个问题：国际象棋的重量。经过一千五百年的积累——从古印度的恰图兰卡，到波斯帝国的沙特朗日，到十五世纪欧洲的规则定型——国际象棋已经不只是游戏。它是歌德所说的“智慧的试金石”，是冷战时期苏联证明制度优越性的文化武器，也是一座被开局理论、残局定式、引擎分析层层堆叠而成的知识金字塔。想触碰它的“美”？先爬上去。
而一个不会下象棋的法国年轻人，用一款肉鸽游戏问了费舍尔和卡尔森都没问出的问题：如果这座金字塔不需要被攀登，而是可以被拆掉呢？
这个年轻人叫保罗·乔瓦尼尼（Paul Giovannini），化名 Blukulélé。他做的游戏叫《千棋百计》（Gambonanza），2026 年 5 月 1 日发售。它的核心设计立场，藏在开发者一句轻描淡写的自白里——“我并非国际象棋专家。意识到这一点非但没有让我气馁，反而激励了我。”
乔瓦尼尼 1998 年出生，法国人，至今已有六年游戏行业工作经验。他的职业生涯起步于超休闲手游工作室——三年时间里，每周制作一个新游戏原型，他称之为“快速迭代的训练”。超休闲游戏的逻辑是抓住一个核心机制，做到够好玩，然后立刻转去下一个项目。
当决定自己制作独立游戏时，他先尝试了一款双摇杆射击游戏《OVERWHELMED》，用时三个月完成。然后又制作了一款塔防游戏《Sunstone War》。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/c500ae23815f4bc964b303178c1abc68.png
完成《Sunstone War》之后，他陷入创作空虚，找不到让自己兴奋的点子。他跟自己说：“别想了，做点什么吧。不要期待，只是做原型。”
然后两个东西击中了他。
第一个是 Netflix 的《后翼弃兵》（The Queen's Gambit）。这部剧让很多人重新看到了象棋的“诗意和电影感”，也让乔瓦尼尼开始在网上下棋，尽管总是一败涂地。他说自己爱上了象棋的美，但每一次对弈都在提醒他：真正的象棋之美被锁在知识的壁垒后面。开局理论、残局定式、引擎分析，想走到能欣赏"美"的那一步，你首先需要投入数百小时去记忆那些和"美"毫不相干的东西。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-p038820Tc.png
第二个是《小丑牌》（Balatro）。乔瓦尼尼说《小丑牌》给了他一次“设计重击”（design slap）：一款游戏怎么能把层层复杂性叠加上去，却仍然保持一切可读？他意识到自己之前对“可及性”的认知是错误的：降低复杂度不是唯一实现可及性之路。用系统涌现替代记忆负担，也是一条路。
以上两条叠加在一起，产生了堪称奇异的化学反应：一个被象棋之美吸引、却被象棋之难排斥的人，决定制作一款别人觉得他“没资格”做的游戏。
这份“外行”身份，给了他一种内行没有的视角。在设计“破坏规则的道具”时，如果设计者是一位象棋大师，可能下意识地守住某些底线，“小兵不能这么强，否则就会违背兵的基本定义”。而一个不知道兵应该多强的人，会把兵做成“吃子后跳过对手回合”，因为在肉鸽的逻辑里，这只是一个有趣的连锁触发机制，和棋理无关。
类似故事在游戏史上有过，也不算少见。《我的世界》（Minecraft）的创作者 Notch 不是建筑师，《矮人要塞》（Dwarf Fortress）的创作者 Tarn Adams 不是历史学家，《Baba Is You》的创作者 Arvi Teikari 不是语言学家。外行视角带来的短板和幸运是同一件事：你看不到“应该怎么做”，所以你只能看到“可以怎么做”。
游戏中的 200 种“奇兵”是被动强化道具，可以增强棋子能力或提供增益效果。它们的命名借用了国际象棋术语“Gambit”中“弃兵求势”的意味，也藏着许多国际象棋文化彩蛋。部分 Boss 与现实棋手有关，另一些道具则来自棋坛梗、开局名和棋子典故。它们不是写给职业棋手的注释，而是写给“喜欢国际象棋文化、但未必会认真背棋谱”的外围玩家的暗号。《千棋百计》也正是为这群人设计的。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/2af9812905fc7c23a12edbc1faa2c70d.png
《千棋百计》的视觉语言是：像素艺术、CRT 复古滤镜，以及游乐场式的明亮配色。商店界面是老虎机和弹珠台，Boss 登场带着街机风格的像素动画，游戏氛围像一台被遗忘在嘉年华角落的街机柜。
乔瓦尼尼给《千棋百计》设定的美学目标，和《小丑牌》的赌场迷幻不在同一个方向。他在接受游戏媒体 Pocket Gamer 采访时给出了自己的关键词：“像是在阁楼里发现的奇怪棋盘游戏，几乎像《勇敢者游戏》（Jumanji）。”
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/bc05f1e666dba45ee302c3b338098089.jpg
低分辨率、扫描线、微微抖动的画面，这些技术痕迹在暗示一种“旧玩具”的质感。玩家拿到的不是一副崭新的国际象棋，而是一盒布满灰尘、规则说明已经丢失、只能靠自己摸索怎么玩的旧棋盘。
这恰好就是游戏想要玩家进入的心理状态：忘记你知道的一切关于象棋的事。你的开局定式、战术模式、对“好棋”和“坏棋”的判断，在这里都不作数。它用一种“业余”的美学包裹了一个“业余”的场景：如果你不会下棋，反而拥有某种优势。
游戏中的马戏团主题进一步放大了这种取向。现实竞技情境下，国际象棋被包裹在沉静、木纹、深色图书馆等关键词编织的精英氛围里，费舍尔本人参加世界冠军赛时要求绝对安静，连摄影师的快门声都会让他分心。而《千棋百计》把对局推入了一个喧闹的游乐场，吃子有华丽的粒子特效，每一轮结束都有老虎机式的结算动画，用嘈杂消解了肃穆。
不过，本作的视听语言并非没有瑕疵。游戏只有一首 BGM——战斗、Boss 战、商店、菜单，全部循环同一首曲子，这个选择在最初几小时里或许营造了一种游乐场沉浸感，但二十五个回合的重复足以让它从“洗脑”变成“折磨”。此外，游戏中的动效不够“激烈”，正反馈不够爽快，欠缺干脆利落的表现力。
《千棋百计》的核心制胜机制并非原有的“将死国王”，而是改成了“吃掉对方全部棋子”。这个改动非常巧妙：古典象棋是一把手术刀，目标单纯，所有战术围绕一颗棋子展开。而“全歼”则把手术刀换成了锤子，你必须持续进攻，持续吃子，不能有闲置回合。一个消极防守的象棋选手或许能撑到和棋，但在《千棋百计》里，五回合内没有任何棋子被吃，棋盘格子就开始随机崩塌，站在上面的棋子会一起坠入虚空。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-P06_rsz88779t.jpg
“崩塌”机制是整个游戏的重要设计，它强制加快了游玩节奏。传统国际象棋对局中，棋手可以花十五分钟思考一步棋，深度计算是核心乐趣之一。而崩塌机制把每一局压缩进一个严苛的时限：你必须进攻，必须交换，必须冒险，残局下“慢慢磨死对手”的从容在这里不存在。
在此节奏基础上，《千棋百计》叠加了肉鸽构筑层，核心道具的“奇兵”。它们是被动强化道具，可以颠覆象棋的基本规则：兵吃子后跳过对手回合，主教可以像皇后一样移动，车死亡时给周围格子加护盾，骑士每回合可以多行动一次等。
奇兵系统的核心设计逻辑是，通过“赋权”，让每颗棋子都能获得碾压全场的能力，让弱势棋子有被选中的理由。一个堆满“奇兵”的 Build，能让小兵变成无限复制的自爆型冲锋单位，甚至可以无限跳过对方回合。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-P07_rsz89123s.jpg
实战中，奇兵之间的协同效应构成了游戏最核心的乐趣，凭借一套连锁反应在一回合内吃掉半张棋盘的爽感和在其他肉鸽游戏中打出一套完美 Combo 的心理动态完全同构。
辅助系统同样在强化“即兴进攻”的取向。预备区系统允许玩家在棋盘外储备至多七颗棋子，随时部署，这让局中战术调度多了一层“还有后手”的暗线。棋盘格升级让每一个格子都可能变成护盾、金矿、陷阱或祝福，把“站位”从战术概念变成了资源管理。兵升格机制保留了国际象棋的“灵魂”，在五格长的微型棋盘上，冲到对方底线只需要三回合；到达底线时，升格的兵可以变成任意一种棋子。
《千棋百计》用肉鸽逻辑重新定义了什么叫“会下棋”，追求的是一种不需要记忆和定式，每一局都从零开始构建的象棋体验。但这里有一个绕不开的问题：当构筑深度足以碾压对手时，对手是谁？
谈这个问题之前，先一起看看另一款游戏。

2018 年，凭借《FTL: Faster Than Light》一举成名的二人工作室 Subset Games，拿出了他们的第二款作品《陷阵之志》（Into the Breach）。这款回合制游戏的战斗设定是：每回合开始前，敌人会把自己的行动意图全部摊在棋盘上。哪只怪物要移动到哪个格子、攻击哪个目标、造成几点伤害，都用箭头和数字标识，一目了然。没有命中率判定，没有战争迷雾，没有“对手到底在想什么”的猜测。

Subset Games 的联合创始人 Justin Ma 和 Matthew Davis 将此称为“完全信息”。他们的设计目标只有一句话：“我们希望每一次死亡，都让玩家觉得是自己的错。”这个决定的连锁反应远远超出了他们的预期，它是多米诺骨牌的第一张：既然敌人意图透明，角色就很容易躲避攻击，于是游戏目标被设定为保护无法移动的建筑物，而非保护自己；既然保护建筑物是核心，武器就不能只造成伤害，必须有位移、阻挡等功能；既然攻击效果必须在一屏内展示清楚，所有武器就只能正交瞄准，也就是上下左右四个方向。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-P0889406X.png
说回《千棋百计》。
高难度下，《千棋百计》中的敌方棋子（AI）常会主动走进玩家布下的陷阱，或直接暴露在攻击范围内。
这里有一个结构性悖论。现有象棋引擎之所以卓越，是因为它们建立在规则完全不变的前提下，通过分析数十亿盘棋局来学习最优策略。而《千棋百计》创造了一个规则不断被改写的环境：200 种奇兵可以组合出无数种局面，棋盘大小从 5×5 逐步扩展到 8×8，格子上的陷阱和护盾让每一个位置的含义不断变化——每一局中，奇兵配置、棋盘状态、棋子数量都是独一无二的，没有十亿盘类似的棋局可供学习。
不过无妨，《陷阵之志》已经提供了一条完全不同的设计路径。
Subset Games 的做法是：不尝试让 AI 尽可能聪明，而是把 AI 的每一步都摊在明处。在《陷阵之志》里，怪物 AI 极其简单，本质上就是遍历所有可攻击目标，挑价值最高的打，加一点随机波动。Justin Ma 的原话是：“我们不喜欢做 AI……在这个系统里，怪物不需要聪明。你可以让它们互相攻击、走进火焰，这些看起来很蠢的行为，在回合解谜的结构里是合理的。”
当 AI 的意图完全透明，AI 的愚蠢就不再是“愚蠢”，而是谜题的一部分。玩家不会再抱怨“对手居然看不出这个显而易见的陷阱”，因为对手的行动变成了一组已知条件，你要做的是在自己的回合里找到最优解。
把这个思路移植到《千棋百计》的棋盘上，同样成立。
如果在每回合开始前，AI 的下一步行动被标注在棋盘上，玩家就拥有了完全信息，也能在深思熟虑后行动。它会从根本上改变《千棋百计》的体验性质：从“对抗博弈”转向“残局解题”。这不是让游戏变简单，而是让失败更可归因；它保留高难度，却把高难度从“猜 AI 会不会犯蠢”转移到“我能不能解出这个局面”。
《千棋百计》的高难度从第四档开始，AI 先手、Boss 无敌、崩塌加速，确实让大量玩家感受到的不是“挑战”而是“折磨”。这引出问题：当一款游戏选择高难度，它在选择什么？
低难度带来的爽感与高难度带来的成就感，并无对错之分。最近《吸血鬼幸存者》（Vampire Survivors）开发工作室发布的新作《吸血鬼爬行者》（Vampire Crawlers）就走向了前者：一款卡牌游戏，决策轻量，反馈密集，玩家只需要做出简单选择就能顺利通关，并因此获得大量好评。《千棋百计》选择的却是另一条路。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-P09_rsz8976LP.jpg
在谈这个选择为什么值得被辩护之前，先谈象棋。
有一个声音已经存在了很久：象棋正在被 AI 取代。AlphaZero 击败鳕鱼（Stockfish）AI 之后，很多人说，AI 已经比所有人类都强了，人类之间下棋还有什么意义？说这话的人，大概率没有看过一场真正的象棋比赛。
2023 年国际象棋世界冠军赛决赛，丁立人对涅波姆尼亚奇（Nepomniachtchi）。那时我还完全不懂棋，但有一个画面至今刻在我脑海里。
丁立人即将获胜的时刻，涅波也意识到了局面。他转头看向奖杯，愣了一秒，又重新回到棋盘上，想要找到翻盘的方法。他伸出手，在即将碰触棋子时又缩了回来，手里不停翻腾着已经吃掉的棋子。最后，他把头扭到一边，身体塌了下去，棋子倒了，嘴唇在颤抖。起身离开时，他被椅子腿绊了一下，踉跄着走下台。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-P108996XI.png
而丁立人没有表现出胜利的狂喜。他双手撑头，沉默不语，好像刚才的厮杀已经耗尽了全部精力。那一刻我想到：就算是世界冠军，在面临失败的时候，也会迷茫、脆弱、手足无措得像个孩子吗？
推倒棋子、被椅子绊倒——这些不是因为他弱。恰恰是因为他太强了。强到知道失败意味着什么，强到无法用“我还没尽全力”来安慰自己。
这也回答了 AI 无法取代的东西是什么。“鳕鱼（Stockfish）”AI 永远不会在算不出来的时候望向奖杯，AlphaZero 永远不会在失败时嘴唇颤抖、身体塌下去、被椅子绊倒。AI 没有身体，没有恐惧感，没有一个在最后时刻依然拼命翻盘的心。

items.title: Magic: The Gathering Designers Detail Reality Fracture’s Jace Arc, Echoed Pairs, and Secret Lair Bundles
items.summary: Magic: The Gathering designers Yoni Skolnik and Meris Mullaley break down Reality Fracture’s Jace storyline, E

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/05/05/header-1778019833054.jpg

Magic: The Gathering’s Reality Fracture set is a Universes Within set after two Universes Beyond sets in succession, but it’s also a little different in that it showcases iconic Magic characters, spells, and more that have been transformed by Jace Beleren.
The Planeswalker has transformed the universe into how he feels it should be, and that means new versions of well-known cards in a sort of “What If?” scenario.

IGN sat down with Yoni Skolnik, former Magic pro and Principal Game Designer, and Meris Mullaley, Worldbuilding Design Manager, to talk about the set’s influences, what comes in a pack, and the Secret Lair bundle.
Magic’s Designers Talk Reality Fracture Influences

Alternate universes are nothing new in pop culture, but I was curious how much last year’s Marvel’s Spider-Man set influenced Reality Fracture. As you can imagine, the genesis of Reality Fracture comes from a much earlier set.
“Some of the ideas go back to Planar Chaos, a set from 2007 that had a lot of What If elements,” Skolnik revealed.
“That set focused on messing with Magic's color pie, putting effects in colors where you wouldn't normally expect them.”
“While we didn't want to return to that exact formula for a What If set, the concept of What If is very compelling as it lets you pay tribute to Magic's devoted fan base.”
“Mark Rosewater [Head Designer] was keen to try the concept again, and it ended up fitting perfectly with the conclusion to Jace's storyline.”
“When developing the Echoed Pairs, most of our learnings came from other Magic IP sets that featured multiple legends,” Mullaley added.

“We chose characters who were (or could plausibly be) active in this current moment of Magic’s timeline. Creatively, we also kept most characters on their home planes rather than showing a multiversal cast of characters arriving on Hexhaven to stop Jace.”
“This helped the story of Reality Fracture keep a narrower focus on the key characters and reduced the amount of “why is this person here” questions.”

“We also see three separate Planeswalker cards for Jace, and we took a similar approach as we did with legends from Edge of Eternities or The Lord of the Rings: Tales from Middle-earth, where we see a character at multiple points along their narrative. Each Jace represents a different point in his journey, reflecting his accumulation of power and readiness to enact his final plan.”
The Jace of the Set
So what about Jace? The blue-hued Planeswalker has been around since Lorwyn in 2007, but has been in the background of events in recent sets.
“In terms of game mechanics, Empower Jace was perfect for making our main character very present even if you only lightly interact with the set,” Skolnik explained.

“For new Magic players who want to go down deeper into the history of Jace, there are a few cards that are specifically stronger with Jace Planeswalker cards, to make the process of going to look back at old cards feel rewarding.”

“Flavorfully, I was very impressed with how the worldbuilding team navigated the character. For new players, we're drawing on timeless fantasy tropes like ‘Dark Wizard's Tower’ and ‘Former Ally Turned Foe’ to make the story approachable, while still having plenty of deeper lore references in the art, and a gripping conclusion to Jace's storyline in the web fiction.”

“It also helps that Jace is such a deeply blue character, which makes understanding his role go hand in hand with understanding blue's place in the color pie. One of the first things many people learn about Magic is that blue players are evil, so having an archetypally blue villain was a natural fit!”

You hear that, blue players? You’re the bad guys here. Still, sticking with multiple versions of cards, I asked about how the Echoed Pairs have been received. For newcomers, Echoed Pairs include normal and Echoverse versions of cards, for example Karn, Argent Defender, and Karn, Gilded Guardian.
“The technology of guaranteeing 1 card from an exciting subset per pack has been very well received since debuting in Dominaria with 1 legend per pack,” Skolnik reveals.
“Going up to 3 legends per pack in Reality Fracture was necessary to guarantee echoed pairs given our printers' constraints, and it made for very exciting packs that fans are loving.”

“I trust we'll one day find another place to deploy this technology of 3 cards in a pack that is linked somehow. This experimentation was not directly related to the 2027 pack changes, but together they show the breadth of problems our production teams face while balancing Magic design's need for constant novelty and reinvention against the reality of what it takes to print all the Magic product for our growing audience!”
Secret Lair Bundle Is Here To Stay
In the time since we spoke with the Wizards of the Coast team, the Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle has been delayed. We asked about whether it’ll be sticking around.
“Yes! Secret Lair Bundle will become a staple of Magic Multiverse sets and is expected to appear in those sets going forward.”

“Part of the impetus for launching these bundles was to consolidate Special Bundles into one incredible package that we could repeat set over set. The theming of Reality Fracture and how we explore Jace’s inner sanctum made a lot of thematic sense to use as the jumping-off point for this new product line.”

So, onto the big question then: as someone who can’t believe their luck by packing Craterclaw Colossus and Hexhaven Invigorator, I was curious what the team’s favorite cards from Reality Fracture were.
“ I really love both Ajani Planeswalker cards,” Skolnik explained.

“Seeing Ajani Resolute in standard Life Gain decks has been great. A 2-mana Planeswalker is very tricky to balance, but with Planeswalkers such a big part of the set, I really wanted to try and print one here.”
“Ajani Unrelenting has been demolishing in draft, but I’m also excited to see it doing work in Commander decks built around Planeswalkers.”
Mullaley’s pick was spoiler-filled, so look away, lore fans.

“Vindictive Triumph depicts one of my favorite moments in the fiction, where [spoilers] Liliana resurrects her Echoverse doppelgänger as a lich and takes the fight to Jace. I read that moment in an early draft of the story and knew immediately it needed to be a card.”
For more on Magic: The Gathering’s current set, check out Reality Fracture’s most expensive cards , as well as the most powerful precons of all time .

items.title: Hideo Kojima Makes Surprise Cameo in New My Chemical Romance Animated Short
items.summary: Death Stranding creator Hideo Kojima showed up for a cameo role in a new animated short from legendary rock ou

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/30/my-chemical-romance-hideo-kojima-1793400372401.png
Death Stranding creator Hideo Kojima showed up for a cameo role in a new animated short from legendary rock outfit My Chemical Romance.

That's probably not the first sentence you expected to read heading into the Halloween weekend, but considering Kojima is known for his love of music, movies, games, and everything in between, it may not be too surprising. Still, fans of his work as a creative powerhouse were probably shocked to see him appear in the credits for the band's new animated short film, Prelude to The End .

The seven-and-a-half-minute project, which arrived as a surprise drop yesterday evening, is a stop-motion, dark fairytale based on director Lauren Tsai's The Dying World. Serving as a vehicle for a 20th anniversary music video for My Chemical Romance's "The End." – the opening track for the New Jersey group's seminal rock record, The Black Parade – the video also enlisted Kojima for a quick voice role.

Just as main character, Astrid, retreats to her room to parse through a few missed calls, we get Kojima's My Chemical Romance music video debut. He's credited simply as The Teacher, and can be heard scolding Astrid about late work in her third voicemail. You can see the full text below.
"Astrid your Japanese homework is late again. This is unacceptab-" Kojima's The Teacher can be heard saying before the recording is cut off.

Kojima is far from a stranger when it comes to cameos, but he's been especially busy in this department lately. The Metal Gear Solid series, which Kojima created and orchestrated for years, features a few moments where he broke the fourth wall for a cameo. He also appeared in CD Projekt Red's Cyberpunk 2077 for a role that he recently reprised in Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 .
https://t.co/MjeYkDAgV5

Kojima's collaboration with My Chemical Romance might have been especially exciting for the game creator, though, as his love for the band's music is well-documented. After posting about some of his favorite merch in early 2022, he shared that he attended one of the band's concerts in 2022. At the time, he said, "When I went to the venue, there were almost all teenage girls. I didn't see any old men in my age. But as I was wearing the band T-shirt, people said to me 'I like your T-shirt, Ojisan.'

Kojima also secretly teased his involvement in Prelude to The End when mentioning he had picked up the 20th Anniversary Edition of The Black Parade on vinyl just a few days ago. He then celebrated his involvement in the video with another post on X/Twitter.

Kojima is in good company when it comes to his My Chemical Romance cameo. Also featured in the list of Astrid's missed voicemails are Lost Weekend songwriter Phoebe Bridgers and Hit Me Hard and Soft hitmaker Billie Eilish. With both Grammy-Award-winning artists sharing a few seconds with Kojima, the moment definitely made sure to pack in as many heavy hitters as it could.

Kojima will seemingly continue to show up in side projects as he stays focused on other projects, including OD and Physint . Last night, we also got the first trailer for the anime spinoff series, Death Stranding Isolations . We know the Kojima Productions mastermind will appear in one live-action cameo , too, though what it will be has yet to be revealed.

items.title: Bungie Says 'Don't Buy Marathon as a Donation' as Destiny Players Look to Support Studio's Future
items.summary: As Bungie plots a future for more Destiny, head of product Josh Deane has clarified that players don't need to

others.title: Bungie 表示不要指望《命运 3》会出现在游戏颁奖典礼上

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/05/24/marathon-blogroll-02-1684962151922.jpg
As Bungie plots a future for more Destiny , head of product Josh Deane has clarified that players don't need to "buy Marathon as a donation" just to support the studio's plans.

It's a clarification that arrived after Deane posted a community message for Destiny fans yesterday. The message, featured as part of a lengthy Q&A blog post , outlined the unvaulting process for Destiny 2 content that was previously promised last month, but one segment left players confused – and concerned – about the future and extraction shooter Marathon's role in the big picture.

"We're not going to forget the mistakes of the past, but it's time to learn from them and unify as one Bungie community," the section in question said. "For us, the majority of our Bungie team is legacy Destiny, and we will all tell you that nothing can help bridge us into future more than for Marathon to rapidly evolve and become sustainable. As we head into our December and March updates for Marathon, it’s a formative period for all of us here at Bungie that will help determine the shape of our future, so please encourage each other and know that your support gives our team the energy to finish the fight."

It's the "nothing can help us bridge us into future more than for Marathon to rapidly evolve and become sustainable" bit that's got the Destiny community so riled up. With the back-and-forth pulling Destiny 2 in and out of the fire all through the span of a few months, some believed Bungie was trying to tell its audience that picking up a copy of its new sci-fi FPS would help keep it and the studio's future secure. Deane stepped in to confirm this is not the case.

The Bungie developer said his intention was not to rest the Destiny revival on the shoulders of the fans that helped breathe life back into it earlier this year. He chalks it up to a mistranslation, "and that's on me."

"In no way is the Destiny plan contingent upon Marathon," Deane added. "Play what inspires you, whatever it is. Mainly hoping we can accomplish our goals in both lanes with a stronger relationship with our entire community!"

I may have worded this clumsily but this is the true heart of what I was trying to say Truly care about community healing and believe that it will help our studio bridge into the future in the most healthy way possible ❤️ Play and share what you are passionate about, whatever that is The Destiny plan moves forward no matter what

When one player suggested they feared they were being encouraged to purchase but never download Marathon just to support Bungie, Deane said , "Oh, don't buy Marathon as a donation or offer anything else."

"It's our job to show up for you," he added. When another fan expressed similar concern, he said , "I truly love the sentiment but only buy or play a thing that inspires you from us / you think is cool! We will find our way back home with Destiny."

So, there you have it: Destiny and Marathon don't depend upon the success of the other. As Bungie principal comms manager Dylan Gafner said , "Two cakes! One big community." That should offer some relief not only to Destiny players who feared their favorite game's future may still be in jeopardy but also to Marathon players who have feared the same.

Negativity has surrounded both games in recent months, with community members on each side going at each other as both struggled. For now, we know that the Destiny franchise will live on with a few projects. These include "celebration" content updates, a project that the team has teased as "Destiny 'Legacy'," and a mysterious "redacted" project.

For Marathon, Bungie will continue to try to revitalize the extraction shooter with Symbiosis this December. The studio also recently reassured players that the extraction component is "still a major part" of the experience as the team experiments with PvE and Deathmatch modes.

What's next for Destiny and Marathon remains to be seen, but it's clear Bungie is putting in the work to keep both afloat. While we wait to see how things pan out, you can see why the studio believes the latter struggled at launch . You can also read about how the Destiny community banded together to help the #SaveMassEffect movement .

items.title: AI-powered game development is 'leading to an explosion of content,' Roblox says, as it brags about 70,000 games published on its platform in the last 5 months alone
items.summary: Two days after Steam admitted it has an AI slop problem, Roblox basically bragged about the same thing.

content.v: Valve recently admitted that it has a problem with AI slop games and clones flooding Steam—it doesn't know what to do about it just yet, but it at least acknowledges that it's an issue. Now we have Roblox, speaking from the other side of that coin in its Q3 2026 shareholder letter , in which it bragged that the July release of Build, its AI-powered "prompt-to-game creation tool," users have published more than 70,000 games.

"During the last three months, we have witnessed an inflection point in AI adoption and content generation in the gaming industry overall, and on Roblox in particular," the letter states. "AI-enabled game creation, automation in code generation and AI supported asset creation are leading to an explosion of content. The time it takes to go from an idea to a playable game is compressing dramatically, and so is the time it takes to adapt a game for new devices."

The "explosion of content" remark is what jumps out at me first and foremost. Is that really a good thing— content , in explosive quantities? That is essentially what Valve is facing on Steam that's widely considered a problem—an ever-growing mountain of content —yet in the world of Roblox, it's a feature, not a bug. And Roblox is not looking to stem the tide.

"We have been embracing AI to accelerate creation since the first release of Roblox Studio Assistant in December 2023," the letter continues. "Over the past month, more than 80% of the top 100 games on Roblox (ranked by hours engaged) used AI tools to accelerate creation, and the number of daily asset uploads to the Roblox cloud tripled month-over-month.

"Since Q2, time spent using AI tools (including Build, Studio Assistant, and external AI via MCP) tripled among our top creators, and those using our MCP server daily grew nearly 5x. In Q3, Break and Steal an Egg and Huss Valley were both created almost entirely with AI and both broke into the Roblox top 20 (ranked by concurrent players). Build is our new prompt-to-game creation tool. Since its alpha launch in New Zealand, Singapore, Serbia and Thailand, more than 500,000 users have used Build—and have published over 70,000 games."
As content becomes abundant, attention and connection become scarce. What sets our distribution apart is that it runs on social connections.
Roblox

Take a moment to think about that: Build launched in July, five months ago, which means we're looking at a rough average of 14,000 games per month. And that's with Build still not fully launched yet, so only a fairly small portion of the Roblox userbase has access to it. I can't help but wonder, with a certain sense of alarm, what will happen when the doors are opened to more populous parts of the world.

Roblox, however, says it is "uniquely positioned to capture this moment," which is seeing "traditional barriers to software and content creation" giving way to a focus on "distribution, audience aggregation, monetization, discovery, and safety."

To further capitalize on that, Roblox has kicked off two new initiatives: Roblox Everywhere, revealed in September as a way to make Roblox games playable outside of the Roblox platform, and the Universal Player, which is basically the reverse of that: "AI is used to seamlessly import any existing game into the Roblox cloud platform while transforming it to run multiplayer, on any device (at the upper edge of the device's performance capabilities), with instant join, instant UGC updates, local 3D, and access to Roblox services for discovery, safety, communication, and monetization."

That's interesting: Details are scant but the idea seems to be to make Roblox a platform for all game developers, akin to Steam, GOG, or the PlayStation Store, with minimal fuss or muss: Just make your game, then zippity-pow it through the AI machine, and suddenly you've got a full-on Roblox game and access to a massive audience that previously would've been much more of a headache to reach. And Roblox gets basically the same: Its goal "is to capture 10% of the global gaming market and an even greater share in the US."

"As content becomes abundant, attention and connection become scarce," the letter says, extolling the virtues of Roblox's platform. "What sets our distribution apart is that it runs on social connections: people come to Roblox to play with their friends, so every new game can reach players through an existing social graph, through friends inviting friends, and through social influencers, which we believe enables great content to find its ideal audience faster than on any other platform."

Maybe Roblox is right. Hell, maybe EA chief Andrew Wilson was right—maybe the future really is all about billions of people cranking out content while corporations fight over where to put it all. It's hard to argue that Roblox hasn't put up serious shareholder value so far, after all, and while Steam doesn't have shareholders it's still making bank, AI slop problem or no. Still, I can't say that making speed and quantity the key indicators of success really represents the kind of future for videogaming that I'd like.

items.title: 《Soulframe》下周将向所有人开放，Warframe 开发者正在为这款奇幻动作角色扮演游戏下个月的“最大、最暴力”更新之一做准备
items.summary: Verse of the Veilands will radically change the structure of the game so it's easier for new players to follow

content.v: After three years of invite-only playtests, Soulframe is opening its doors to everyone next week on November 6. If you've been waiting to see what the developers of Warframe are doing with a fantasy action RPG, you'll finally be able to jump in and see for yourself.

The transition to an open alpha will be followed by a massive transformation to the structure of the game later in November. Midrath, Soulframe's big open landmass, won't be the verdant, almost chill, place it used to be: The entire area will be corrupted and it's your job to bring it back to life. "You're going to enter a game that is much more unforgiving and harsh at first glance," creative director Geoff Crookes explained in a recent presentation attended by PC Gamer.

This update, Prelude 17 or Verse of the Veillands, is a huge shift for Soulframe, but an important one that will help new players acclimate to the world. Crookes said the goal is to improve the onboarding experience and to give players "much more ownership" over their decisions early on. It won't be fully finished yet, however, so what's in there today is just "the functional bones" of what will come in the final game.

Feedback from players who struggled to reach the point of the game where they could freely explore the open world convinced the team there needed to be a more direct intro. In Verse of the Veilands, the main quest will teach you how to stop the siphons draining the world of its color. Enemies and resources you encounter will change as each zone is restored and side activities, like fishing, will become available. You'll also be able to raise a wolf pup into a full-on mount.

"The system is also helping the worldbuilding," Crookes said. Pages and pages of new writing for each faction leader will be added and you'll start to hear them radio in and fill you in on the history of the world. The team said it wants them to have a more "integrated" role in your journey as you work to cleanse Midrath of the corruption.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zWcRzK3W6VGrHrcaStUDTa-1920-80.png

A new Pact, Soulframe's equivalent of a class (or a Warframe), will be added, too. The name of it was still undecided during the presentation, but the developers described it as a "hunter, poacher-type Pact" related to the alien Ode race. Equipping it will let you tie enemies together with a sci-fi bola, pierce them with a cone of spikes, and send them flying away by attaching a giant balloon to them à la Metal Gear Solid 5.

The developers stressed that there's a lot packed into Verse of the Veilands, so much so that they were still tweaking things days before the presentation. Crookes and McGregor nervously expressed that it would "hopefully" be done in time for today, but it seems it won't quite make it in time. That said, the plan is for the update to be out before the end of the next month, so new players might want to wait until then.

"I think this is probably one of the biggest, most violent changes we've made to the structure of the game in a long while," lead designer Scott McGregor said. "Paired with open Preludes is nerve-wracking and we hope players and the feedback stays positive."
The final (final_vfinal_finalfinal.exe) version of everything in Verse of the Veilands will be shown during a stream later today on the Soulframe Twitch channel .

items.title: VRChat Devs Spark Outrage After Refusing to Include AI Label Despite 95% of Fans Asking for It
items.summary: The developers of VRChat have created a rift in the virtual platform’s user base after announcing that it woul

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/30/vrchat-devs-spark-outrage-over-ai-label-1793390533984.jpg

The developers of VRChat have created a rift in the virtual platform’s user base after announcing that it would not include labels to categorize AI-generated content, despite around 95% of users asking for some sort of AI filter in a survey.

VRChat is a virtual hub where folks can gather to chat, make their own avatars, and create and play games together. It’s a fairly popular social platform that, perhaps unsurprisingly, is a hotbed for viral moments and hilarious content.
Also unsurprisingly, there’s been a sharp increase in AI-generated content in VRChat, to the point where fans are begging for some sort of distinction as to what has and hasn’t been made by humans.

In fact, the folks behind VRChat recently published a survey asking users for their feedback on the state of the platform. In that survey, “95% of survey respondents want some kind of label for AI usage,” as told in an official blog published on October 28.

Despite this overwhelming majority, the powers that be have decided against moving forward with an AI label, arguing that there’s simply too much disagreement among users as to what, exactly, should be done to delineate such content.

“We’re not adding an ‘AI-generated’ label or AI filters,” the devs said in the blog post. “While we think some creators would honestly label their content, we think others would try to pass off generative or assisted work as completely authored by hand. Likewise, we could see this creating ‘sleuthing’ behavior, where folks would attempt to sniff out ‘AI’ content or might harass other creators, even if they are genuinely not using any AI tools in their workflow. We think this potentially creates negative behavior spirals we don’t want to encourage.”
The statement continued, revealing that respondents gave “3,141 different combinations of labeling,”and that “no single combination was given by more than 10% of respondents.”
Essentially, the team at VRChat feels they need to “understand this a layer deeper before making any kneejerk decisions” — but their explanation hasn’t been well-received by fans.

On social media, dedicated VRChat users are speaking out against this decision, with one writing on X/Twitter, “Then what was the point of the survey if they’re not going to f**king use it to influence decisions?”
“95% of YOUR players said NO to AI content. That isn't a debatable margin,” another argued .
“The point of having a filter is because we do NOT want to see that content. They are FILTERS for a reason, bruh,” another exasperated user wrote .

Thus far, VRChat has made no official response to this outrage and is continuing to move forward with planned events, leaving users beside themselves as they work to make their voices heard by the platform.

items.title: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown Review So Far
items.summary: After six hours with this beefy DLC, it seems to add even more to Crimson Desert’s buffet-style approach while

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/30/crimson-desert-charting-the-unknown-blogroll-01-1793388254836.jpg

Crimson Desert’s biggest strength is in the sheer volume of stuff it throws at you, allowing you to spend hundreds or even a thousand-plus hours doing everything from hunting animals with a bow to developing a gambling addiction at the tavern. So it’s not very surprising that Crimson Desert’s first paid DLC, called Charting the Unknown, prioritizes adding more on top of its already staggeringly large repertoire. So far, the interesting new activities that mostly focus on oceanic adventures are exactly as compelling as you’d hope, with ship-to-ship combat, underwater exploration, and romance options being among the list of new worthwhile features. On the other hand, existing activities that have added content, like the extra story missions, have mostly been uninspired retreads that don’t do anything to improve upon their established shortcomings. When Crimson Desert came out, I said that its content was a mile long and an inch deep, and for better or worse this DLC seems to say, “Here’s another half-mile.”

The most disappointing part of the DLC so far has been the additional story missions, which are only accessible once you’ve completed the base game’s already dense main story (a feat which only 10% of Steam players have done, judging by the achievements system). At least the handful of missions I’ve completed at this point have mostly served as an expanded epilogue of sorts, with Kliff fighting more difficult versions of old bosses from the existing story, and Damiane and Oongka fleshing out their less substantial stories as well.

I’m not far enough to know if any of these quests eventually become more interesting, but most of their objectives have been an oddly bland retracing of your steps, like going back to spend time with a familiar character and share a moment fishing together or arm wrestle someone to gather information as an apparent callback to an identical moment in the original story. I did get to a new stretch of the map just before getting distracted by the separate seafaring content, so hopefully this part of the DLC will pick up the pace, but so far it’s been about as unimpressive as I expected given the low bar for storytelling in Crimson Desert.

Much like the base content though, most of the effort seems to have been put into things that aren’t related to the story. Although most of my time has been spent dipping my toes into the water-based ship-crafting feature that’s the focus of this expansion, it feels like I’ve only seen the tip of the iceberg, with new resources to obtain, crewmates to hire, and even more activities to learn like harpooning fish and ship-to-ship combat before you can really begin your voyages properly.

It's going to take more time to fully engage with these new activities and judge whether or not they have the sea legs to keep me entertained for longer than a few hours, but at least right now I’m just impressed (yet again) by the fact that these systems exist in this adventure that’s already so damn packed with things to do. Gliding underwater on the back of a sea turtle and captaining your own pirate crew truly just feel completely bizarre in the context of Crimson Desert, and so far that’s been compelling enough to keep me moving forward even if some of the other added content isn’t great.

There’s still a ton I have to investigate, like additional base building and property management features, a challenging combat arena-style gauntlet, and my personal favorite – social links and romance mechanics for NPCs, which I’m very excited to check out once I’ve gotten my bearings (I’m just not ready to settle down yet, okay?!).
What I said about Crimson Desert

"There’s lots to love about this quirky, kitchen sink design, and I admire that it’s managed to pack a metric ton of unique mechanics and interesting areas into one package. But it takes work to dig your way through the thick layer of gunk that covers it all, and the mostly competent action-adventure game that’s buried beneath is only sometimes worth that effort." (March 20, 2026)
Score: 6
Read the full review

For all the stuff that’s been added, one thing that is the same since the last time I played is the number of bugs I’ve encountered in my brief time with the Charting the Unknown DLC. I’ve already had two hard crashes, one character wig out on me while I was trying to arm wrestle him (he was hilariously standing behind me during the match, arm bent unnaturally), and quite a few blurry or flickering textures that are impossible for me to not focus on during cutscenes. I’m still too early to tell if this is going to be a consistent issue, but in my time so far it’s been quite rocky from a technical perspective considering how much wonkiness I’ve encountered per hour played.

As expected with Crimson Desert, it’s going to take quite a bit of time to see and do enough to reach a definitive conclusion on Charting the Unknown, and I’m hopeful that the engaging and unexpected content that’s been added will be able to make up for some of the activities that feel like empty calories.

items.title: MTG Darkhold Destiny 4 Commander Deck Bundles: Do They Look Good or Not?
items.summary: Are MTG Darkhold Destiny's Commander bundles worth $299.96 or $639.96? Here's what's included and whether the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/18/magic-the-gathering-darkhold-destiny-commander-deck-bundle-1792353467227.jpg

Magic: The Gathering’s latest Marvel crossover is still nearly six months away, but Amazon preorders are already up for bundles containing four Darkhold Destiny Commander decks, though one is definitely more hefty in ptice than the other.
Whilst the standard four-deck bundle is currently selling for $299.96 on Amazon , the Collector’s Edition is going for $639.96 — both sold directly by the retailer, and launching on April 9, 2027.

Depending on which one you’re eyeing up, this works out to $74.99 or $159.99 each respectively. Understandably, that’s quite a high entry price and knock on potential trading card budgets, so you need to know exactly what you’re getting for your money, and whether that initial cost seems worthwhile, based on first impressions.
What comes in the Darkhold Destiny Commander Bundles?
No matter which price you pay, either Darkhold Destiny Commander bundle comes with the following decks: Strange Academy, Gods of Asgard, Midnight Sons, and Lords of Hel.
Each deck has 100 cards and is completely ready-to-play, containing 30 new-to-Magic Commander cards; that’s along with ten double-sided tokens, a deck box, and a strategy guide.

The difference between the two bundles is that the standard version comes with two Traditional Foil legendary creatures per deck; the Collector’s Editions, meanwhile, swap in Surge Foil treatments across all 100 cards.
Do these Commander decks actually look good?
Amongst the many preorders up for Darkhold Destiny in general, the Commander Decks definitely look at least interesting on paper.

For instance, with Strange Academy, Doctor Strange leads a white-blue-black blink deck that’s built around sending creatures out of play and bringing them back to make repeated use of their enter-the-battlefield effects, as pointed out by Wargamer . Since it’s quite a tried-and-tested strategy, there could be plenty of mileage with this deck, though it depends what the new cards will actually do effects-wise.

Meanwhile, Lords of Hel has Hela commanding a red-black token sacrifice deck; that’s another promising combo, but that depends on the payoff you get for sacrificing those creatures. In contrast, Thor’s red-green-white Gods of Asgard focuses on equipment and creatures with power four or more, whilst Blade’s white-black Midnight Sons revolves around Vampires, building life, and spending it to trigger abilities.

Considering the price, it is at least a relief to see that these are four Marvel-themed decks with more variety than doing the same thing. Plus, with the expansion itself, as we learned when it was announced , Darkhold Destiny is set to be the first Universes Beyond set building around an original story shared between Marvel and Wizards of the Coast.

On the other hand, until we see the full decklists, we can’t at least 100% determine whether all decks will be objectively good in the game’s meta when Darkhold Destiny comes out. That said, if you loved the original Marvel Super Heroes expansion and are excited to see more, it should be at least safe to pre-order the standard $299.96 bundle — and wait until further down the line to decide on the Collector’s Editions.

items.title: Hedgehog Dies After Being Spray Painted Blue to Look Like Sonic
items.summary: An animal rescuer is condemning vandals who spray-painted a hedgehog blue, presumably to make it look like Seg

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/04/10/sonic-the-hedgehog-2-biplane-stance-1712785795787.jpg
An animal rescuer is condemning vandals who spray-painted a hedgehog blue, presumably to make it look like Sega’s beloved mascot character, Sonic the Hedgehog .

The heartbreaking story comes from West Yorkshire in the UK, where a male hedgehog was found with extensive chemical burns after being spray-painted blue by supposed vandals. The animal was discovered outside the Wakefield police station and subsequently brought to Castleford Hedgehog Rescue on Tuesday, October 27, for treatment.

Unfortunately, the poor critter didn’t make it. Local reports state that the spray paint literally burned through “several layers” of the hedgehog’s skin, to the point where it melted its spines, causing extreme pain.

29-year-old Beth Campbell, who operates the hedgehog rescue, says she tried everything in her power to help — but the pain was so severe that the defenseless animal literally “screamed himself to death.”

"I don't know how anyone could be so cruel to an animal. It is disgusting,” she told YorkshireLive. "I haven't seen anything as bad or as sad as this in a long time. …I'm glad he was brought in, as it meant at least we could ease his suffering and make him feel comfortable."

Campbell says the spray paint gave the hedgehog significant chemical burns that, in turn, triggered an infection on its now-exposed skin. This, along with potential poisoning from the chemicals in the spray paint, is what ultimately caused its death.

She also revealed that the hedgehog was suffering from a condition known as flystrike, which occurs when flies lay their eggs in animals’ open wounds or soft tissue, resulting in maggots that feast on their flesh. Spray paint aside, Campbell said that the critter would have likely undergone a "slow and ultimately and extremely painful death" in the wild.

On Facebook , the hedgehog rescued posted a heartwrenching tribute to the deceased hedgehog: “As a result of cruelty our poor boy has passed away. This has deeply affected our volunteers and myself as he laid screaming in pain, he was given the full amount of pain relief he could have," the group wrote.

“Rest peacefully little man, the way you were treated was horrific, we tried everything we possibly could to save you, but you were too precious for this cruel world. Pain free, running free across the rainbow bridge.”

Campbell said she plans to report the incident to police, but is unsure if any action will be taken, given the location where the animal was found. Thus far, no arrests have been made, and local police have not released a statement regarding the matter.

Hedgehogs are listed as a nearly threatened species globally and are classified as vulnerable for extinction within the UK. Populations of the animal have dropped between 30-75% since 2000, with expanding human activity impacting their ability to find food, shelter, and otherwise survive.

Ubisoft said more Assassin's Creed games are on the way, but don't expect to see remakes like Black Flag Resynced anytime soon.

The publisher behind the history-hopping stealth-action franchise laid all its cards on the table in a lengthy update post yesterday. Considering that this year's Assassin's Creed 4 remake seemed to go off without a hitch when it launched in July, one might assume re-imaginings for other games are on the way – but that is not the case.

When spelling out where Assassin's Creed has been and where it's heading, Ubisoft plainly addressed desires for more re-imaginings in a section called 'What About Other Remakes?' It knows Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced has fans chomping at the bit for more, but it doesn't sound like we'll be getting any more for a very long time.

"One thing we want to be transparent about today is that we currently have no other Assassin's Creed remake actively in development," it said. "Our teams are already focused on the next chapter of Assassin's Creed titles, including projects you haven't heard about yet, featuring new settings and stories."

Why not revisit older games? Black Flag has remained a beloved installment in the franchise even more than a decade after its original release, but fans have continued to clamor to revisit stories from games like the original Assassin's Creed , Assassin's Creed 2 , and Assassin's Creed 3 . As happy with Black Flag Resynced as Ubisoft is, the publisher admitted that returning to the West Indies took more than a little legwork.

"As our first-ever franchise remake, Resynced taught us a tremendous amount," it explained. "Taking on a game that holds such a special place in players' hearts brought both excitement and challenges. Rebuilding old systems from scratch, adding new elements that fit the experience, and balancing legacy with innovation was a massive undertaking. We're super proud of what the Resynced team delivered and how well it was received."

Unfortunately, we won't be donning Altair or Ezio's Assassin cloaks anytime soon. Still, just because no remakes are in development now, it doesn't mean there won't ever be an opportunity to return to fan-favorite worlds and stories.

"But don't mistake that for a closed door. Like many of you, we love the idea of revisiting our classic titles, and we'll keep exploring opportunities to bring older titles back. That door remains open because, after all... Nothing is true, everything is permitted."

Of course, that doesn't mean the Creed is going anywhere. Ubisoft also acknowledged that its teams are "focused on the next chapter of Assassin's Creed titles," which includes projects fans "haven't heard about yet, featuring new settings and stories." One of those is Codename Hexe , another game that it made sure to touch on in its update post . In May, the publisher said the plan was to deliver new games in the Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, and Ghost Recon franchises over the course of the next few years .

IGN gave Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced a 9/10 review . We said, "More than just a shinier version of the same game you remember, Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced brings what was already one of the best games in the series up to today’s standards." Its final major content update added New Game+, Nightmare difficulty, and more earlier this week.
